mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers a labor market tightening, boosting confidence in economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline when UNRATE crosses below 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicators reflects robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline when both proxies rise (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, sustained inflation below 2% (CPIAUCSL) reduces policy uncertainty and supports equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline when CPIAUCSL <2.0% (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% during a labor market recovery phase signals improved labor conditions, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline when UNRATE drops below 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in demand (GDPC1) and demand-driven economic activity (RSAFS) strengthens market confidence, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline when both proxies rise (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-quarter window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in the supply index (INDPRO) above 105.0 during an expanding economy indicates healthy production, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO crosses above 105.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: During expansionary monetary policy (FEDFUNDS <4.0% and CPIAUCSL <2.0%), reduced policy tightness and inflationary pressures enhance market optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly higher than baseline when both proxies meet trigger conditions (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-quarter window.
